study: Six requested factors: conditional position sizing with and without an announcement clock
evaluation: Annual walk-forward 2005-2025, each model fit on prior ten calendar years only; fixed families and hyperparameters, no selection using evaluation returns
paired_comparison: Identical model, train rows, noncycle controls, rebalance dates, optimizer and cost scenarios. Only announcement features differ. Plain equal-weight factor also shown.
base_inputs: Signed factor rank, lagged Mom12m rank, prior 63-session realized volatility, lag capitalization, dollar volume, price and long/short leg
cycle_inputs: Known release age phase harmonics, forecast clock and pre/post flags; interactions with factor rank and long/short leg. No realized future release dates.
training: Deterministic max30 stocks per leg per factor each fifth market session; each observed date/leg equally weighted. Signed daily payoff target clipped to +/-20% during estimation only. Training rows ending before evaluation year. Training-fitted medians/means/scales. Predictions capped +/-1% per day.
variance: Ridge log residual squared regression, training-calibrated arithmetic variance, 50% shrinkage to lag stock variance; no claim of full covariance optimality
allocation: Every fifth session, maximize 5*mu'a - 5*10/2 sum sigma_i^2(a_i-b_i)^2/b_i -c sum|a_i-p_i| separately per leg. b_i=1/n, sum a_i=1, .5b_i<=a_i<=min(1.5b_i,.2). Two legs +1/-1 of after-fee NAV. Holdings drift between rebalances. This is a regularized diagonal-risk tracking optimizer, not an unconstrained Markowitz optimum.
availability: Factor and Mom12m exact prior-calendar-month snapshots, strict existing regular-cycle / >=5 analyst coverage universe. Source signal construction inherits vintage/revision limitations.
minimum_names: First five factors >=20 names EACH side, RDIPO >=5 each side explicitly concentrated sensitivity; RDIPO raw0 long, raw1 short. Cash if threshold fails on rebalance. No requirement that held names stay eligible between scheduled rebalances.
costs: 0bp+0borrow diagnostic, 5bp+1% annual borrow primary, 10bp+1% annual borrow stress; each scenario own optimizer/holdings/NAV; all dollars bought/sold charged including terminal liquidation. No impact, financing, rebate, observed stock loan or terminal data corrections.
inference: Paired daily net differences with HAC60 CI; Holm over all 36 factor/model pairs per scenario/period. Net positivity also tested with Holm36. Spanning intercept vs paired baseline, local VW market, and Mom12m factor net portfolio; CER gamma3, Sharpe, turnover and monthly HAC3. Joint success requires positive adjusted incremental mean and own net mean. Family scope excludes unrecorded earlier searches.
interpretation: Retrospective chronological research; related holdouts previously inspected; all six factor papers published after 2004. User monthly historical net-return ranges are unverified context and are not local baseline returns. No claim of live/untouched OOS or official Fama-French alpha.
